text:
Sara: Kicking off canary for /generate-v2 at 18:00 UTC. Plan below — short ramp with region cohorts. @Ken can you own the first hour smoke checks?

Sara: Ramp schedule (target):
- 18:00 UTC: 5% global (US-EAST + low-weight EU)
- 18:30 UTC: 20% (add EU-WEST)
- 19:15 UTC: 50% (add APAC low)
- 20:00 UTC: 100% if green

Sara: Smoke checks:
- p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-per-request cost delta
- quick sample of 50 requests for content/regressions
- verify KV cache hit rate not dropping

Ken: got it, i'll be on from 17:55–19:10 UTC. I'll post checks every 15m.

Hugo: who is the deployer? which job?

Sara: i'll trigger the job: infra/deploys/generate-v2-canary (CI job). Ashley will monitor infra metrics.

Maria: linking the quick runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-smoke (use the "canary-checklist" section).

Ken: quick commands i'll run (posting here):
```
# tail latency and error rate
curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=service_latency | jq .result
curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=error_rate | jq .result
```

Ashley: I'll watch cluster GPU memory and queue length. If queue depth > 2x baseline or OOMs spike, call immediate pause.

Sara: Rollback criteria (explicit):
- error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m
- p95 increase > 200ms vs baseline
- token cost up > 15% (unexpected)

Sara: Rollback command (manual):
```
# revert canary config
ci trigger infra/deploys/generate-v2-canary --action=rollback --reason="auto/ops"
```

Ken: noted, will ping #oncall and here if anything unusual.

deploy-bot: Started canary for generate-v2 at 1769304600. Cohorts: us-east(5%), eu-west(2%), eu-low(1%).

Hugo: small request — can we keep the canary variant pinned to quantized-8bit for the first 30m? helps isolate perf changes.

Sara: yes, pinning to quantized-8bit for first two ramps. after 50% we'll evaluate switching.

Maria: if all green i'll approve full rollout at 20:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Ashley: i'll post a short summary at 20:05 with metrics and notes.

Ken: first 15m check (18:15) — p50 85ms (ok), p95 240ms (+30ms), errors 0.4% (ok). continuing.

Sara: thanks team — i'll start the job at 18:00 and update here when job finishes step 1.
